name: TypeScript Engineering
description: Preserve the project's types, avoid new any, and prove the change with the TypeScript compiler.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read the types around the change.
Find the existing type used for this value.
Change the TypeScript without widening types.
Run tsc and report its result.
Read file and line diagnostics from the compiler.
Run tests when the type change has a runtime effect.

validation.rule: run_typecheck completed, and no new any was added unless the surrounding code already uses any for that case.
